Randall\n            <jats:italic>et al<\/jats:italic>\n            . used an array of nuclear spins surrounding a nitrogen vacancy center in diamond as their many-body quantum system. Subjecting the system to a series of periodic driving pulses, they observed ordering of the spins occurring at twice the driving frequency, a signature that they claim establishes the formation of a discrete time crystal.
